meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress natural language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to save input tokens. Preserves all technical substance, code, URLs, and structure. Compressed version overwrites the original file. Human-readable backup saved as FILE.original.md. Trigger: /caveman-compress FILEPATH or "compress memory file"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩记忆文件为精简格式,节省输入令牌
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常感觉上下文空间不够,想减少大模型费用
copy.tagline_en: Compress memory files into a compact form to save tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run out of context space and want to cut AI costs

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把指定的记忆文件(如 CLAUDE.md、待办、偏好)压缩成原始人格式,以减少输入 token;保留代码、链接、技术名词和原有结构,压缩结果覆盖原文件,并在外部目录留下可读的 `.original.md` 备份。
howto.when: 当你说出“/caveman-compress 文件路径”或“compress memory file”,或要求压缩记忆文件时触发。

say.note: 压缩该文件并创建可读备份

say.text: 把 preferences.txt 压缩成原始人格式
say.note: 压缩后原文件被覆盖,备份在外部目录
按默认流程压缩记忆文件

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude compresses specified memory files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to reduce input tokens. It preserves code, URLs, technical terms, and structure, overwrites the original, and saves a readable .original.md backup in an external data directory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say '/caveman-compress <filepath>' or "compress memory file", or ask to compress a memory file.

say_en.note: Compresses the file and makes a readable backup.
